trainer.dialogueBefore: Psychic Bryce: I foresaw a trainer coming through this cave today. How our battle ends, I haven't seen... yet.
trainer.dialogueAfter: Psychic Bryce: Ah. Now I see it clearly. I lost.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Black Belt Miles: Victory Road is the finest training ground in Sinnoh! One more bout before I climb on!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Black Belt Miles: Four arms, and not one of them fast enough. More training!

trainer.dialogueBefore: Bird Keeper Hana: Even in a cave, my birds always find their way. Let's see if you can find yours!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Bird Keeper Hana: You'll find your way to the League. I'm sure of it.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Ace Trainer Mariah: Everyone in Victory Road has eight Badges. Don't go thinking you're special!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Ace Trainer Mariah: ...All right. Maybe you're a little bit special.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Veteran Edgar: I've walked this road more times than I can count, and never reached its end. Show me how it's done!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Veteran Edgar: So that's how. Perhaps this will be my year after all.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Dragon Tamer Clinton: My dragons have grown up in these caves. Soon they'll be ready to fly!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Dragon Tamer Clinton: Not ready yet, then. Neither am I.
